description: This file defines API routes for managing organizations within a multi-tenant RBAC backend system, including create, list, retrieve, update, and delete operations. It uses FastAPI and SQLAlchemy for database interactions and enforces role-based access control.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing an organization (tenant) in the system.

classes.name: AuditLog
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model for recording audit logs.

classes.name: OrganizationCreate
classes.description: Pydantic schema for creation of an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationOut
classes.description: Pydantic schema for returning organization data.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Provides a generator that yields a SQLAlchemy Session for database interactions.

methods.name: None _audit(db: Session, org_id: int, user_id: Optional[int], action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: Optional[str], details: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Internal helper function to write an audit log entry for organization actions.

methods.name: OrganizationOut create_organization( payload: OrganizationCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role("admin")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new organization; requires admin role.

methods.name: List[OrganizationOut] list_organizations( db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role("admin")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list all organizations; restricted to admins.

methods.name: OrganizationOut get_organization( org_id: int = Path(..., description="Organization ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role("admin")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch a specific organization by ID.

methods.name: OrganizationOut update_organization( payload: OrganizationCreate, org_id: int = Path(..., description="Organization ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: User = Depends(require_role("admin")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update the name of an organization by ID.

methods.name: None delete_organization( org_id: int = Path(..., description="Organization ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: User = Depends(require_role("admin")), )
methods.description: API endpoint to delete an organization by ID.
